tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /stobs 'phrog dbang po'i bskang bshags mdor bsdus shig/ na mo gu ru tsa tur mu kha ye/ hūm̐ lha mchog ma hā kā la mthu bo che/ /khyed la mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /rta g.yag lug khyi nag po dar nag brgyan/ /rakta dmar chen khrag gi arghaṃ dang / /dri ldan me tog la sogs nyer mchod lnga/ /rkang gling snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi sgra sgrogs cing / /dam rdzas rgyan gtor bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod/ /dza gad za btung ri dang rgya mtsho tsam/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul ting 'dzin sngags brgyar ldan/ /mahā kā la zhal bzhi gzi ldan dbang / /bram ze'i gzugs can yum chen sring mo bzhi/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang gyur nas/ /rnal 'byor dpon slob nyams chags gsos gyur cig /gdong bzhi dregs pa sogs rgyun bzhin no/ /zhes me khyi lo bstan 'gro spyi dang / bye brag dpal sa skya'i sku rims su kha'u brag rdzong gi me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang du stobs 'phrog dbang po la lo gcig ring gtor ma 'dzugs dgos pa'i mtshan ma shar skabs sa skya pa kun blos bskang bshags kyi rtsa bsog ched gnyan lo tsā ba'i gsungs las btus pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 klu sgrub/ stobs 'phrog dbang po'i bskang bshags mdor bsdus/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
